# [CS061] Recently Published Dependency Version (dependency-young-module)

A required version was published less than min_module_age_days ago.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Supply Chain & Provenance |
| **CWE** | [CWE-1357](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1357.html) |
| **OWASP** | A03:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Compromised maintainer accounts and malicious packages are usually found within days of publication. Waiting before adopting a new release gives that process time. The publication time comes from the module proxy; modules under allowed_prefixes and of your own account are skipped.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```text
require github.com/acme/fresh v1.0.0 // published two hours ago
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```text
require github.com/acme/fresh v0.9.4 // published three weeks ago and reviewed
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [dependency-young-module]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    dependency-young-module: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore dependency-young-module -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** dependency-young-module
```
